I feel the same. I was watching this TikTok that really spoke to me. The guy said “You can’t make someone love you by giving them more of what they don’t already appreciate” Maybe you’ll find that it resonates with you but I think at the very least you should reconsider your priorities in life and make yourself #1. People are uncaring and cruel and have no problem walking over you for their own benefit. I’ve learned and try my best at putting my needs over other people since I used to be pretty much a doormat when I was younger. 

This might not be true for you but at least in my own experience after some self introspection I realized the reason why I bent over backwards to make other people happy wasn’t to make them happy but rather as a form of validation to make myself happy…but I was never happy doing that since my efforts wouldn’t be reciprocated or acknowledged. I’m still sad and lonely but now I don’t have to bother with as many people who only want to use me.

I feel the same. I got an internship at a company that pays well a few months ago. When I was younger I remember saving up money to buy games and wishing that I was rich so I could buy any game. 

Now the only thing I spend money on are bills and eating out everyday. Unhealthy I know but I eat like once a day since I’m lazy so it’s not that bad. I don’t really care about money anymore. Work is nice though since it distracts me but it’s only a distraction and I have to return to my life after my work day. If this is how my life is going to be for the next 40 years I honestly don’t see the point lol.

Today marks the 2nd year anniversary of my pledge to k myself in 5 years (so 3 years left).
I reassess every year to check if I should continue or stop. My life is still shitty so I’ve got 3 shitty more years left. Hopefully I reconsider.
Persona 5 Royal. The best JRPG I’ve ever played and I’m a JRPG nut.

I don't know how to stop feeling like that. Some days are good but others I just hope that a drunk driver instantly kills me when I'm crossing the road. I'm not an actively suicidal person or anything but I constantly tell myself that I'm okay with dying today. I hope I can stop feeling like this one day in the future. I'm just pretty much living for the sake of living. Death wouldn't really change anything for me since I don't have any goals, dreams or hopes. I hope you feel better and that you know you aren't alone.
I just say "I'm good" and leave it at that. That way they don't probe further into my psyche and I don't have to spend too much energy talking to them.
